text: Schedule No. (1) Bill of Quantities for 6 October Northern Extensions - 220/22/22 kV GIS Substation. Supply and installation of 220 kV GIS, Power Transformer 60 MVA, 22 kV Switchgear. Tender security EGP 500,000 valid for 180 days. Experience: similar 220kV GIS projects in last 5 years. Schedule: 12 months delivery. Consortium: joint venture allowed.

1- 220/22/22 kV, 175 MVA Transformers
2- 220 kV GIS
3- 220 kV GIS Circuit Breaker
Commercial terms: Fixed price, payment in EGP, delivery 12 months, penalty for delay 0.5% per week, termination clause. The contractor shall submit audited financials turnover 100M EGP.

Tender Document Volume 1 - 6 October Northern Extensions. Tender No. Mobile-2024-001. Client: NUCA - New Urban Communities Authority. Location: 6th October City. Voltage: 22-22-22 kV GIS. Experience: successful continuous operation 3 years with similar 220kV projects. Financial capacity: audited financials turnover 100M EGP. Deadline: submission 15 of March, 2024. Consortium: joint venture allowed.

Section 2: Technical Specifications. The 220kV GIS shall be rated 2500A, 50kA for 1 second. Type tests: Routine tests and type tests for GIS per IEC 62271-100. Manufacturer: Hyosung or equivalent. OEM authorization required.

Technical Specification Part 1: Power Transformer 60 MVA, 220/22-11kV, ONAN cooling, vector group YNyn0. Experience: bidder must have completed 2 similar 60MVA transformers in last 5 years. Reference projects required.

Clarification 1: The tender security shall be submitted as bank guarantee. Validity 180 days from opening. No additional financial guarantee required. HSE: Health, Safety and Environment program must be submitted. QA/QC: Quality assurance plan per ISO 9001.
Drawing: Single line diagram for 22-22-22 kV GIS substation. No textual requirements on this page — only diagram and title block.

Section 3: Commercial Conditions. Payment terms: 10% advance, 80% on delivery, 10% retention. Currency: EGP. Taxes: VAT 14% included. Penalty for delay: 0.5% per week max 10%. Termination: employer may terminate for default with 14 days notice.
Section 4: Legal Conditions. The tenderer must be registered Egyptian Union for Construction Contractors First Category. Legal status: consortium joint and several liability. Applicable law: Egypt.
Tender Price Schedule — التوسعات الشمالية — 6 October Northern Extensions. Schedule No. 1: Supply of 220 kV GIS — Quantity 2 — Unit Price — Total. Schedule No. 2: Power Transformer — Quantity 2.

Personnel requirements: Key personnel — Project Manager 10 years experience, Design Manager, Site Manager. CVs must be submitted. Subcontractor: maximum 30% of works may be subcontracted, subcontractor experience required.
HSE Requirements: Health, Safety and Environment program, safety officer, emergency plan. QA/QC Requirements: Quality assurance plan, type tests, routine tests, factory acceptance tests.
Form C: Tenderer's Schedule — Programme. The contractor shall submit detailed programme within 14 days of award. Completion: 12 months from commencement.
